profiles.label: Light manufacturing
profiles.area_defined: All buildings where employees are present.
profiles.day_occurrence: Open during production, assembly, packaging, and administrative shifts.
profiles.night_occurrence: Open or closed depending on facility operations, with possible reduced staff.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for light manufacturing plants, assembly plants, electronics factories, garment factories, food processing plants, packaging plants, and small industrial workshops. Good evidence includes workers, employees, staff, or contractors physically present, on shift, inside, trapped, rescued, evacuated, or counted during an inspection. Treat production capacity, workforce size, directory, and company profile pages as context only.
preferred_source_types: official emergency or public-safety incident report
official workplace safety or labor regulator incident report
official company incident statement with a count-bearing detail
context_only_source_types: company profile page without a count-bearing event or incident
production capacity, annual output, or workforce size page
social media repost without an original authoritative source
profiles.component_source_guidance: Harvest these values as source-backed component inputs, not final occupancy estimates. Preserve the source quote, unit, time basis, and geography level for each value.
